title: 【李豆沙】打歌服没召唤出来，公主抱倒是先来了

witness.answer: {"lidousha_primary":true,"thumbnail_readable":true,"single_clear_hook":true,"text_overcrowded":false,"title_cover_aligned":true,"physical_text_line_count":2,"unrelated_or_misleading_elements":[],"reason":"白发小熊猫耳少女是画面主体之一，封面两行大字清晰呈现“打歌服没来但公主抱先来”的反差，和标题完全一致。","pass":true}
